name: All Star Bulk Order Block
description: All Star Embroidery bulk ordering, artwork review, and WooCommerce My Account experience.
changelog:
1.3.0

  • Removes the full-page Intro and opens directly on Items, with a concise first-visit New here? popup.
  • Uses Items → Artwork → Checkout progress and fixes the frontend progress grid to three columns.
  • Moves the block into the All Star Embroidery inserter group with a built-in category fallback.
  • Aligns shipping to the current $10 flat-rate reference and recognizes previous approved artwork as already covering digitizing/setup.
  • Total Saved now reports real volume savings plus the real shipping saving; ASBO does not introduce or pretend to remove a $15 cart fee.
  • Preserves ASBO tier pricing, Supplier Sync boundaries, cart metadata, protected artwork workflow, and the v1.2.5 My Account project hub.
